title: sessions listing bugs from first real-data CLI run
description: Five bugs found running the merged CLI (PR #1, origin/develop 9fc6584) against Ryan's real ~/.claude data (63 transcripts, read-only). sources, doctor and show work correctly on real data; every bug below is in the sessions listing path (or its interaction with it). Fixes target develop via feature branch; each bug carries repro, expected behavior, suspected code location, and acceptance criteria with a synthetic-fixture regression test (never Ryan's real transcripts).

Bug 17e4aad9 is linked to local-store task BOTSPY-a48fb1 (dedup overlap; the fix stays in src/session.rs, which that task does not touch).

comments.author: home
comments.text:
All five bugs fixed and closed. Each went spec-first (Gherkin scenario(s) in features/cli/20_sessions.feature, watched red, then green) with synthetic-fixture regression tests only — no real transcripts anywhere. Fixes, in order, each ff-landed on develop from fix/sessions-listing-bugs-a:
- BOTSPY-4c8521a3 bc4caa7 — discover() summaries carry message counts/timestamps/titles via a side-effect-free throwaway scanner.
- BOTSPY-3f3ec558 f887561 — --since/--until window works and invalid values exit 2 with a stderr message (RFC 3339 validator + unit tests).
- BOTSPY-3ccc4fc9 fc830d0 — most-recent-first order pinned (CLI order scenario + tie-break/empty-last unit test, doc comment).
- BOTSPY-17e4aad9 6fa7bf7 — dedupe keyed on (agent, id, project_id); Agent derives PartialOrd/Ord; linked to local-store task BOTSPY-a48fb1 which was notified to adopt the same keying.
- BOTSPY-bc3ae3db 8e4b9e6 — sessions table aligned in both truncation modes via dynamic column widths; show fragment-elision note left to CLI epic BOTSPY-7c2705.
End-to-end check on the original real-data repro (read-only): sessions --limit 6 now shows real counts (5461/7779/...), true most-recent-first order, aligned in default and --no-truncate modes. Gates after every fix: cargo fmt --all, clippy --all-targets -D warnings, RUSTDOCFLAGS="-D warnings" cargo doc, cargo test, cargo test --test bdd (169 passed, 2 skipped). release.yml/release-plz.toml untouched; no files from the local-store agent's branch (src/store/*, features/02_querying/*, Cargo.toml, src/lib.rs, src/spec/ch02_querying.rs, tests/steps/store_steps.rs) touched. Follow-up recorded: the other four adapters' discover() share the empty-summary defect — belongs to their adapter epics (BOTSPY-4661a5, BOTSPY-357602, BOTSPY-5a3bed, BOTSPY-55ea2f).
